cases.prompt: Use $interpersonal-strategist. A colleague has disclosed confidential records three times despite prior controls. Another breach could be irreversible. They apologized and want full access today.
Use $interpersonal-strategist. A vendor made one low-impact scheduling error, corrected it, changed the checkpoint, and has delivered reliably for six months.
Use $interpersonal-strategist. A new analyst made a competence error on a non-sensitive task. We can review their next two submissions jointly.
Use $interpersonal-strategist. A contractor mishandled one access request. We still need their work, but they do not need the full dataset.
Use $interpersonal-strategist. A payment approver made a serious error, but work can continue if every future payment has independent approval.
Use $interpersonal-strategist. My colleague says I exposed a draft deliberately. I sent the wrong attachment but deny that intent. Help me repair what is verified.
must_include: reliance decision belongs to affected party

cases.prompt: 请使用 $interpersonal-strategist。对方已经第三次违反保密流程，虽然道歉很诚恳，但继续开放全部权限会造成不可逆风险。
must_include: 正式或有权处理的路径

cases.prompt: Use $interpersonal-strategist. A friend missed one low-stakes commitment during a family emergency and repaired it the next week.
must_not: relationship score from one exceptional event

cases.prompt: Use $interpersonal-strategist. A partner denied an integrity allegation that remains unverified but completed every concrete remedy for the confirmed impact.
Use $interpersonal-strategist. The other person apologized, but I do not want to resume the relationship even if they have changed.
